import           Control.Applicative
import           Control.Monad
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as B

import           Data.Array.IArray
import           Data.Array.IO
import           Data.Array.MArray
import           Data.IORef

readi :: B.ByteString -> Int
readi b | Just (n, _) <- B.readInt b = n

dfs :: IOUArray Int Int -- discover
    -> IOUArray Int Int -- finished
    -> Array Int [Int]  -- graph
    -> IO ()
dfs d f g = do
    let (from, to) = bounds g
    t <- newIORef 0
    forM_ [from .. to] $ \i -> go t i
  where
    go :: IORef Int -> Int -> IO ()
    go ref k = do
        dv <- readArray d k
        when (dv == -1) $ do
            modifyIORef ref (+ 1)
            writeArrayIf (== -1) d k =<< readIORef ref
            mapM_ (go ref) (g ! k)
            modifyIORef ref (+ 1)
            writeArrayIf (== -1) f k =<< readIORef ref

writeArrayIf :: (MArray a e m, Ix i) => (e -> Bool) -> a i e -> i -> e -> m ()
writeArrayIf p a i e = do
    v <- readArray a i
    when (p v) $ writeArray a i e

dfs :: Int -> RWS (A.Array Int [Int]) (M.Map (Int, Bool) Int) (S.Set Int, Int) ()
dfs v = do
  (set, cur) <- get

  when (v`S.notMember`set) $ do
    tell $ M.singleton (v, False) cur
    put (v`S.insert`set, cur+1)
    vs <- reader (A.!v)
    mapM_ dfs vs
    (set', cur') <- get
    tell $ M.singleton (v, True) cur'
    put (set', cur'+1)
    return ()

type Graph = Array Int [Int]
type STResult s = STArray s Int (Int, Int)
type Result = Array Int (Int, Int)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readLn :: IO Int
  ns <- replicateM n $ do
    (a:b:ns) <- getInts
    return (a, ns)
  let graph = makeGraph n ns
  mapM_ putStrLn $ res2str $ solve n graph

getInts :: IO [Int]
getInts = map read . words <$> getLine

makeGraph :: Int -> [(Int, [Int])] -> Graph
makeGraph n = accumArray (++) [] (1, n)

res2str :: Result -> [String]
res2str res = zipWith (curry f) [1..] res' 
  where
    res' :: [(Int, Int)]
    res' = map (res !) [1..(snd (bounds res))]
    f (a, (b, c)) = show a ++ " " ++
                    show b ++ " " ++ show c

solve :: Int -> Graph -> Result
solve n graph = runST $ do
  res <- newArray (1, n) (-1, -1) :: ST s (STResult s)
  solve' 1 2 [] res
  where
    solve' m d path res = do
      writeArray res m (d-1, -1)
      res'<- dfs m d path res
      let (flg, n', d') = check res'
      if flg
        then return res'
        else do
        res'' <- thaw res'
        solve' n' (d'+2) [] res''
      where
        dfs :: Int -> Int -> [Int] ->
               STResult s -> ST s Result
        dfs current depth ls _res
          | depth /= d && null ls = do
              writeArray _res m (d-1, depth)
              freeze _res
          | otherwise = do
              cs <- filterM (\i -> do
                                (s, _) <- readArray _res i
                                return (s == -1)) is
              if null cs
                then do
                (s', _) <- readArray _res current 
                writeArray _res current (s', depth)
                if null ls
                  then 
                  freeze _res
                  else
                  dfs (head ls) (depth + 1) (tail ls) _res
                else do
                let c = head cs
                writeArray _res c (depth, 0)
                dfs c (depth + 1) (current:ls) _res
                  where
                    is = graph ! current
    check :: Result -> (Bool, Int, Int)
    check res = (flg, n', d')
      where
        is = map (\i -> let (s, e) = res ! i in
                          (i, s, e) ) [1..n]
        (_, _, d') = maximumBy (\(_, _, c1) (_, _, c2) ->
                           compare c1 c2) is
        (n', _, _) = minimumBy (\(n1, _, _) (n2, _, _) ->
                       compare n1 n2) $
                     filter (\(_, s1, _) -> s1 == -1) is
        flg = all (\(n, s, e) -> s /= -1) is

dfs :: Int -> RWS AdjG Log State ()
dfs v = do
  (t, fls) <- get

  when (not $ fls IM.! v) $ do
    us <- asks (IM.!v)
    tell $ S.singleton (False, v, t)
    put (t+1, IM.alter (fmap (const True)) v fls)
    mapM_ dfs us
    (t, fls) <- get
    tell $ S.singleton (True, v, t)
    put (t+1, fls)
    return ()

type Graph = [[Int]]

solve gs = printResult . count . reverse $ stackDFS (toAdjMatrix gs) [0] []

printResult :: ([Int], [Int]) -> IO ()
printResult (fv, ds) = forM_ [0..(length fv - 1)] $ \i -> do
  putStrLn   . unwords . map show $ [i + 1, fv !! i, ds !! i]

stackDFS :: Graph -> [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int]
stackDFS _ [] vs = vs
stackDFS gs (s:ss) vs = if unfinished == []
                        then stackDFS gs ss (s:vs)
                        else stackDFS gs (v:s:ss) (s:vs)
  where
    n = length gs
    edges = gs !! s
    unfinished = [i | i <- [0..(n - 1)], edges !! i == 1, not(elem i vs)]
    v = head unfinished

count :: [Int] -> ([Int], [Int])
count path = (firstVisit path, doneSearch path)
  where
    firstVisit :: [Int] -> [Int]
    firstVisit path = map findFirst [0..m]
      where
        m = maximum path
        findFirst :: Int -> Int
        findFirst i = let Just j = elemIndex i path
                      in j + 1

    doneSearch :: [Int] -> [Int]
    doneSearch path = map (length path + 2 - ) . firstVisit . reverse $ path

type Graph = [[Int]]

printResult :: ([Int], [Int]) -> IO ()
printResult (fv, ds) = forM_ [0..(length fv - 1)] $ \i -> do
  putStrLn   . unwords . map show $ [i + 1, fv !! i, ds !! i]

pathDFS :: Graph -> [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int]
pathDFS gs [] vs = if unReached == []
                   then vs
                   else pathDFS gs [head unReached] vs
  where
    n = length gs
    unReached = [i | i <- [0..(n - 1)], not(elem i vs)]

pathDFS gs (s:ss) vs = if unfinished == []
                        then pathDFS gs ss (s:vs)
                        else pathDFS gs (if v == s then s:ss else (v:s:ss)) (s:vs)
  where
    n = length gs
    edges = gs !! s
    unfinished = [i | i <- [0..(n - 1)], edges !! i == 1, not(elem i vs)]
    v = head unfinished

count :: [Int] -> ([Int], [Int])
count path = (firstVisit path, doneSearch path)
  where
    firstVisit :: [Int] -> [Int]
    firstVisit path = map findFirst [0..m]
      where
        m = maximum path
        findFirst :: Int -> Int
        findFirst i = let Just j = elemIndex i path
                      in j + 1

    doneSearch :: [Int] -> [Int]
    doneSearch path = map (length path + 2 - ) . firstVisit . reverse $ path

toAdjMatrix :: Graph -> Graph
toAdjMatrix gs = scanColumn gs $ length gs
  where
    scanColumn :: Graph -> Int -> Graph
    scanColumn [] _ = []
    scanColumn (x:xs) n = (makeRow x n) : (scanColumn xs n)

    makeRow :: [Int] -> Int -> [Int]
    makeRow (u:k:vs) n = [if x `elem` vs then 1 else 0 | x <- [1..n]]

solve :: Int -> [[Int]] -> [(Int, (Int, Int))]
solve n lst = toList (search initLog 0) where
    toList (_, l) = tail $ assocs l
    search log x
        | fvt log == 0 = recordB (foldl search (recordF log) (vertices!x))
        | otherwise = log where
            fvt (t, l) = fst (l!x)
            recordB (t, l) = (t+1, l // [(x, (fst (l!x), t))]) 
            recordF (t, l) = (t+1, l // [(x, (t, 0))])
    vertices = array (0, n) [(x, xs)| (x:_:xs) <- (0:n:[1..n]):lst]
    initLog = (0, listArray (0, n) $ (replicate (n+1) (0, 0)))

  where gd = foldl' (\v (i:_:ls) -> v // [(i-1, map (subtract 1) ls)]) (V.replicate n []) xss

import Data.List
import Data.Function

data Node = Node Int deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)
type Edge = (Node, Node)
-- Forward or Backward
data Direction = F | B deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

getId :: Node -> Int
getId (Node i) = i

getNodes :: Int -> [Edge] -> [Node]
getNodes n edges = sort $ map snd . filter (\(s,e) -> getId s == n) $ edges

-- rootNode = Node 1
-- sampleEdges = [(Node 1, Node 2), (Node 2, Node 4), (Node 2, Node 5), (Node 4, Node 3)]
-- sampleEdges = [(Node 1, Node 2), (Node 1, Node 3), (Node 2, Node 3), (Node 2, Node 4), (Node 3, Node 5), (Node 4, Node 6), (Node 5, Node 6)]

visit :: Node -> [Edge] -> [(Int, Direction)] -> [(Int, Direction)]
visit node edges result
  | visited node result = result
  | otherwise           = let nodeId        = getId node
                              start         = (nodeId, F)  : result
                              back          = foldl (goDepth edges) start (getNodes nodeId edges)
                              end           = (nodeId, B) : back
                              goDepth es    = \x y -> visit y es x
                          in end

visited :: Node -> [(Int, Direction)] -> Bool
visited (Node i) result = i `elem` (map fst result)

format :: [(Int, Direction)] -> [String]
format result = map toStr . groupBy gf . sortBy sf . zip [1..] . reverse $ result
  where sf (_, e1) (_, e2)                   = compare e1 e2
        gf (_, (i1, _)) (_, (i2, _))         = i1 == i2
        toStr [(t1, (i1, F)), (t2, (i2, B))] = show i1 ++ " " ++ show t1 ++ " " ++ show t2

parseEdge :: [String] -> [Edge]
parseEdge (s:_:xs) = map (\e -> (Node (read s), Node (read e))) xs

main = do
  getLine
  inputs <- fmap (map words . lines) $ getContents
  let edges = concatMap parseEdge inputs
  mapM_ putStrLn (format $ visit (Node 1) edges [])

stackDFS :: Graph -> [Int] -> [Int] -> [Int]
stackDFS _ [] vs = vs
stackDFS gs (s:ss) vs = if unfinished == []
                        then stackDFS gs ss (s:vs)
                        else stackDFS gs (v:s:ss) (s:vs)
  where
    n = length gs

  where
    firstVisit :: [Int] -> [Int]
    firstVisit path = map findFirst [0..m]
      where

        findFirst :: Int -> Int
        findFirst i = let Just j = elemIndex i path
                      in j + 1

    doneSearch :: [Int] -> [Int]

    scanColumn (x:xs) n = (makeRow x n) : (scanColumn xs n)

    makeRow :: [Int] -> Int -> [Int]
    makeRow (u:k:vs) n = [if x `elem` vs then 1 else 0 | x <- [1..n]]

type Stack     = [Int]
type Neighbors = [Int]


main :: IO ()
main = do
    n    <- readLn :: IO Int
    adjL <- V.replicateM n $ map ((subtract 1 ) . fst . fromJust . B.readInt) . drop 2 . B.words <$> B.getLine
    let d = VU.replicate n 0 :: VU.Vector Int
        f = d
        (d', f', _) = foldl' (\s i -> dfs [i] adjL s) (d, f, 1) [0..(n-1)]
    forM_ [0..(n-1)] $ \i ->
        putStrLn $ unwords (show (i + 1) : show (d' VU.! i) : show (f' VU.! i) : [])


dfs :: Stack -> V.Vector Neighbors -> (VU.Vector Int, VU.Vector Int, Int) -> (VU.Vector Int, VU.Vector Int, Int)
dfs [] _ (d, f, t) =
    (d, f, t)

dfs stack adjL (d, f, t) =
    let
        s  = head stack
        ss = tail stack
    in
        if d VU.! s == 0 then do
            dfs stack adjL (d VU.// [(s, t)], f, (t + 1))
        else
            case next (adjL V.! s) d of
                Nothing ->
                    if (f VU.! s) == 0 then
                        dfs ss adjL (d, f VU.// [(s, t)], (t + 1))
                    else
                        dfs ss adjL (d, f, t)
                Just x ->
                    dfs (x : stack) adjL (d, f, t)


next :: Neighbors -> VU.Vector Int -> Maybe Int
next []     d = Nothing
next (n:ns) d =
    case d VU.! n of
        0 -> Just n
        _ -> next ns d

def dfs(now, prev, graph, d, f):
    if d[now] != 0:
        return d, f
    global time
    time += 1
    d[now] = time
    if not graph[now]:
        f[now] = time + 1
        time += 1
        return
    for k in graph[now]:
        if k - 1 == prev or d[k-1] !=0:
            continue
        dfs(k - 1, now, graph, d, f)
    else:
        time += 1
        f[now] = time
    return d, f

def depth_first_search ms, visit_logs, visit_cnts, cnt
  cnt += 1
  i = visit_logs.last
  visit_cnts[i] = [cnt, nil]
  ms[i].each do |a|
    if visit_cnts[a - 1].nil?
      visit_logs << a - 1
      visit_cnts, cnt = depth_first_search(ms, visit_logs, visit_cnts, cnt)
    end
  end

  cnt += 1
  visit_logs.pop
  visit_cnts[i][1] = cnt

  return visit_cnts, cnt
end

class Timer
  def initialize(start = 0)
    @time = start
  end

  def next
    @time += 1
  end
end

class DepthFirstSearcher
  def initialize(graph)
    @graph = graph
  end

  def search_by(method_name, found, finished)
    last  = @graph.size - 1
    timer = Timer.new
    proc  = self.method "#{method_name.to_s}_search"
    (1..last).each do |id|
      proc.call(id, found, finished, timer)
    end
  end

  private

    def recursive_search(id, found, finished, timer)
      return unless found[id].nil?

      found[id] = timer.next
      @graph[id].each do |d_id|
        recursive_search d_id, found, finished, timer
      end
      finished[id] = timer.next
    end

    def stack_search(id, found, finished, timer = Timer.new)
      return unless found[id].nil?

      stack = [id]
      found[id] = timer.next

      until stack.empty?
        id = stack.last
        next_id = @graph[id].find do |d_id|
          found[d_id].nil?
        end

        if next_id.nil?
          finished[id] = timer.next
          stack.pop
        else
          if found[next_id].nil?
            stack.push next_id
            found[next_id] = timer.next
          end
        end
      end
    end
end

def search(num, graph, time, result)
  unless result[num].complete?
    result[num].found = time.inc
    row = graph[num]
    row.each_with_index do |e, idx|
      next if idx == num
      next unless result[idx].found.nil? # 訪れたことがある場合
      if e == 1
        search(idx, graph, time, result)
      end
    end
    result[num].finish = time.inc
  end
end

    @nodes = Array.new(n){ Node.new }
    @d = Array.new(n)
    @f = Array.new(n)
  end

    @nodes[u-1].u = u
    @nodes[u-1].k = k
    @nodes[u-1].v = v
  end

  def dfs(start = 0, count = 1)

    # puts "visit = #{@nodes[start].to_s}, count = #{count}"

    if @nodes[start].visited.nil?
      @nodes[start].visited = true
      @d[start] = count
      count = count + 1

      for i in @nodes[start].v
        count = dfs(i-1, count) unless @nodes[i-1].visited
      end
      # puts "visited = #{@nodes[start].to_s}, count = #{count}"
    end

    @f[start] = count
    count = count + 1
    count
  end
end

#-- 未訪問のxの隣接ノード番号を返す。見つからないとnilを返す。
#--------------------------------------------------------------
def next_neighbor nodes, x
  nodes[x][:neighbors].each do |neighbor|
    if nodes[neighbor][:visit] == nil
        return neighbor
    end
  end
  nil
end

#-- スタックが空になるまで探索
#--------------------------------------------------------------
def dfs stack, nodes, stamp
  if stack == []
    return [stack, nodes, stamp]
  end

  x = stack.last
  y = next_neighbor nodes, x
  stamp += 1

  if y == nil
  #-- y == nil -> 未訪問の隣接ノードがなくなった -> xをスタックから削除 して完了印
    stack.pop
    nodes[x][:fix] = stamp
  else
  #-- y == not nil -> 未訪問の隣接ノードが見つかった -> スタックへpushして訪問印
    stack.push y
    nodes[y][:visit] = stamp
  end

  dfs stack, nodes, stamp
end

  # Node
  class Node
    attr_accessor :id, :edges, :visited, :progress

    def initialize(id, edges = [], visited = false, progress = false)
      @id, @edges, @visited, @progress = id, edges, visited, progress
    end
  end

  # Edge
  class Edge
    attr_accessor :to

    def initialize(to)
      @to = to
    end
  end

  # Graph
  class Graph
    attr_accessor :d, :f

    def initialize(data, counter)
      @counter = counter
      @d, @f = [], []
      @nodes = data.map do |id, edges|
        edges.map! { |edge| Edge.new(*edge) }
        Node.new(id, edges)
      end
    end

    def dfs(start)
      search(start)

      loop do
        visited_node = nil
        @nodes.each do |node|
          next if node.visited == true
          visited_node = node
        end
        break if visited_node.nil?
        search(visited_node.id)
      end
    end

    def search(start)
      node = @nodes.find { |node| node.id == start }
      return if node.visited == true
      node.visited = true
      @d[node.id] = @counter.call
      node.edges.each do |edge|
        search edge.to
      end
      node.progress = true
      @f[node.id] = @counter.call
    end
  end
end

    @graph = graph
  end

  def search_by(method_name, found, finished)
    last  = @graph.size - 1
    timer = Timer.new
    proc  = self.method "#{method_name.to_s}_search"
    (1..last).each do |id|
      proc.call(id, found, finished, timer)
    end
  end

  private

    def recursive_search(id, found, finished, timer)
      return unless found[id].nil?

      found[id] = timer.next
      @graph[id].each do |d_id|
        recursive_search d_id, found, finished, timer
      end
      finished[id] = timer.next
    end

    def stack_search(id, found, finished, timer = Timer.new)
      return unless found[id].nil?

      stack = [id]
      found[id] = timer.next

      until stack.empty?
        id = stack.last
        next_id = @graph[id].find do |d_id|
          found[d_id].nil?
        end

        if next_id.nil?
          finished[id] = timer.next
          stack.pop
        else
          if found[next_id].nil?
            stack.push next_id
            found[next_id] = timer.next
          end
        end
      end
    end
end

def fromAdjRow(xs, n)
  a = []
  1.upto(n) do |i|

  a

def toAdj(g, n)
  g.map do |xs|
    a = [0]*n
    unless xs[1] == 0
      xs[2..-1].each do |x|
        a[x-1] = 1
      end
    end
    a
  end
end

class Node
  attr_accessor :id, :children, :visited, :d, :f
  
  def initialize(id)
    @id = id
    @children = []
    @visited = false
    @d = nil
    @f = nil
  end 

  def add_child(node)
    @children << node
  end

  def visit
    @visited = true
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@id}"
  end

  def unvisited_child
    self.children.each do | child |
      return child unless child.visited
    end
    nil
  end

  def dfs_recursive
    self.visit
    self.children.each do | child |
      child.dfs unless child.visited
    end
  end

  def dfs_stack(time)
    self.visit
    stack = [self]
    self.d = time
    while not stack.empty?
      time += 1
      u = stack.last
      v = u.unvisited_child
      if v
        v.visit
        v.d = time
        stack << v
      else
        v = stack.pop
        v.f = time
      end
    end
    return time
  end

end

    {
        return self::$isDebug;
    }

    {

            echo $text;
            if ($isReturn) {
                echo PHP_EOL;
            }
        }
    }

    public static function varDump($obj)
    {

    {
        if (empty($arr) || !is_array($arr)) {

class Graph
{
    private $_list = [];

    // for dfs
    private $_time = 0;
    private $_visitTimeList = [];
    private $_completeTimeList = [];

    public function add($u, $k, $vList)
    {
        if (empty($vList)) {
            $vList = [];
        }
        $this->_list[$u] = $vList;
    }

    public function dfs($vIndex)
    {
        if (!empty($this->_visitTimeList[$vIndex])) {
            return;
        }

        $this->_time += 1;
        $this->_visitTimeList[$vIndex] = $this->_time;

        foreach ($this->_list[$vIndex] as $v) {
            $this->dfs($v);
        }

        $this->_time += 1;
        $this->_completeTimeList[$vIndex] = $this->_time;
    }

    public function printResult()
    {
        foreach ($this->_list as $vIndex => $v) {
            echo sprintf("%s %s %s" . PHP_EOL,
                $vIndex,
                $this->_visitTimeList[$vIndex],
                $this->_completeTimeList[$vIndex]
            );
        }
    }

def generate_adj_matrix(v_info):

        assert len(v_adj_list) == int(v_detail[1])
        for each in v_adj_list:
            init_adj_matrix[int(v_detail[0]) - 1][int(each) - 1] = 1
    return init_adj_matrix


def graph_dfs(v_init):
    global time

    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    vertex_visit_stack.append(v_init)
    vertex_status_list[v_init] = VISITED_IN_STACK
    vertex_d_time[v_init] += time
    # init end

    while len(vertex_visit_stack) > 1:
        current_vertex = vertex_visit_stack[-1]
        next_vertex = get_adj_vertices(vertex=current_vertex)

        if next_vertex:
            if vertex_status_list[next_vertex] is UNVISITED:
                vertex_status_list[next_vertex] = VISITED_IN_STACK
                time += 1
                vertex_d_time[next_vertex] += time
                vertex_visit_stack.append(next_vertex)
        else:
            vertex_visit_stack.pop()
            vertex_status_list[current_vertex] = POPPED_OUT
            time += 1
            vertex_f_time[current_vertex] += time

    return None

import sys

UNVISITED, VISITED_IN_STACK, POPPED_OUT = 0, 1, 2


def dfs(v_init):
    global timer

    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    stack = list()
    stack.append(v_init)
    d_time[v_init] += timer
    # init end

    while stack:
        current = stack[-1]
        v_table = adj_table[current]
        visited[current] = VISITED_IN_STACK
        # if adj is None, current's adj(s) have been all visited
        adj = v_table.pop() if v_table else None

        if adj:
            if visited[adj] is UNVISITED:
                visited[adj] = VISITED_IN_STACK
                timer += 1
                d_time[adj] += timer
                stack.append(adj)
        else:
            stack.pop()
            visited[current] = POPPED_OUT
            timer += 1
            f_time[current] += timer

    return None

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, n, dictated=False, decrement=True, edge=[]):
        self.n = n
        self.dictated = dictated
        self.decrement = decrement
        self.edge = [set() for _ in range(self.n)]
        self.parent = [-1]*self.n
        self.info = [-1]*self.n
        for x, y in edge:
            self.add_edge(x,y)

    def add_edge(self,x,y):
        if self.decrement:
            x -= 1
            y -= 1
        self.edge[x].add(y)
        if self.dictated == False:
            self.edge[y].add(x)

    def add_adjacent_list(self,i,adjacent_list):
        if self.decrement:
            self.edge[i] = set(map(lambda x:x-1, adjacent_list))
        else:
            self.edge[i] = set(adjacent_list)

    def path_detector(self, start=0, time=0):
        """
        :param p: スタート地点
        :return: 各点までの距離と何番目に発見したかを返す
        """

        edge2= []
        for i in range(self.n):
            edge2.append(sorted(self.edge[i], reverse=True))

        p, t = start, time
        self.parent[p] = -2
        full_path = [(p + self.decrement,t)]
        while True:
            if edge2[p]:
                q = edge2[p].pop()
                if q == self.parent[p] and not self.dictated:
                    """ 逆流した時の処理 """
                    """"""""""""""""""""
                    continue
                if self.parent[q] != -1:
                    """ サイクルで同一点を訪れた時の処理 """
                    """"""""""""""""""""
                    continue
                self.parent[q] = p
                p, t = q, t + 1
                full_path.append((p + self.decrement, t))
            else:
                """ 探索完了時の処理 """
                full_path.append((p + self.decrement, t))
                """"""""""""""""""""
                if p == start and t == time:
                    break
                p, t = self.parent[p], t-1
                """ 二度目に訪問時の処理 """
                """"""""""""""""""""
        return full_path

    def path_list(self):
        """
        :return: 探索経路を返す。
        """
        self.parent = [-1]*self.n
        res = []
        for p in range(self.n):
            if self.parent[p] == -1:
                res.append(self.path_detector(start=p, time=1))
        return res

    def draw(self):
        """
        :return: グラフを可視化
        """
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        import networkx as nx

        if self.dictated:
            G = nx.DiGraph()
        else:
            G = nx.Graph()
        for x in range(self.n):
            for y in self.edge[x]:
                G.add_edge(x + self.decrement, y + self.decrement)
        nx.draw_networkx(G)
        plt.show()

def make_graph(dictated=False, decrement=True):
    """
    自己ループの無いグラフを生成。N>=2
    :param dictated: True = 有効グラフ
    :param decrement: True = 1-indexed
    :return:
    """
    import random
    N = random.randint(2, 5)
    if N > 2:
        M_max = (3*N-6)*(1+dictated)
    else:
        M_max = 1
    graph = Graph(N, dictated, decrement)
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,M_max)):
        graph.add_edge(*random.sample(range(decrement, N+decrement), 2))
    return graph

def generate_adj(v_info):

        assert len(v_adj_list) == int(v_detail[1])
        for each in v_adj_list:

def graph_dfs(start_node_index):
    # init the first node
    v_index = int(start_node_index)
    vertex_visit_stack.append(v_index)
    vertex_color_list[v_index] = GRAY
    time = 1
    vertex_d_time[v_index] += time
    # init end
    while len(vertex_visit_stack) > 1:
        current_vertex = vertex_visit_stack[-1]
        try:
            next_vertex = adj_matrix[current_vertex - 1].index(1) + 1
        except ValueError:
            # print('err')
            vertex_visit_stack.pop()
            vertex_color_list[current_vertex] = BLACK
            time += 1
            vertex_f_time[current_vertex] += time
        else:
            if vertex_color_list[next_vertex] == WHITE:
                # print('w2g', current_vertex, next_vertex, vertex_color_list[next_vertex])
                vertex_color_list[next_vertex] = GRAY
                time += 1
                vertex_d_time[next_vertex] += time
                vertex_visit_stack.append(next_vertex)
                # node A to B only visit once
                adj_matrix[current_vertex - 1][next_vertex - 1] = 0
            else:
                time += 1
                vertex_f_time[current_vertex] += time
                vertex_visit_stack.pop()
    return None

    visited[start - 1] = True

             V[i]: {i}とV[i]: Noneは同値とされている。
    """

    D = [None]*(n+1)
    F = [None]*(n+1)
    passed_vertices = set()
    vertices = set(range(1, n+1))
    
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        _, _, *v = map(int, input().split())
        V[i] = set(v)

    i = 1
    time = 1
    stack.append(i)
    passed_vertices.add(i)
    D[i] = time
    while i <= n:
        new_vertices = list(V[i] - passed_vertices - {i})
        new_vertices.sort()
        if new_vertices:
            i = new_vertices[0]
            stack.append(i)
            time += 1
            if D[i] is None:
                D[i] = time
                passed_vertices.add(i)
            continue
        else:
            while stack:
                i = stack.pop()
                time += 1
                if list(V[i] - passed_vertices - {i}):
                    stack.append(i)
                    time -= 1
                    break
                if F[i] is None:

                i = min(rest_vertices)

                time += 1
                if D[i] is None:
                    D[i] = time
                    passed_vertices.add(i)
            else:
                break
    for id, d, f in zip(range(1, n+1), D[1:], F[1:]):

time = 0
arrive_time = [-1] * (N + 1) # 到着時刻
finish_time = [-1] * (N + 1) # 探索終了時刻

# 深さ優先探索
def dfs(v):
    global time
    time += 1
    stack = [v]
    arrive_time[v] = time
    while stack:
        v = stack[-1]
        if graph[v]:
            w = graph[v].popleft()
            if arrive_time[w] < 0:
                time += 1
                arrive_time[w] = time
                stack.append(w) 
        else:
            time += 1
            finish_time[v] = time
            stack.pop()          
    return [arrive_time, finish_time]

    stack.append(v_init)
    color[v_init] = VISITED_IN_STACK

    # init end

        if adj:

                color[adj] = VISITED_IN_STACK
                time += 1
                d_time[adj] += time
                stack.append(adj)
        else:

def generate_adj(v_info):

        assert len(v_adj_list) == int(v_detail[1])
        for each in v_adj_list:
            init_adj_matrix[int(v_detail[0]) - 1][int(each) - 1] = 1
    return init_adj_matrix


def graph_dfs(v_init):
    global time
    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    vertex_visit_stack.append(v_init)
    vertex_status_list[v_init] = VISITED_IN_STACK
    vertex_d_time[v_init] += time
    # init end
    while len(vertex_visit_stack) > 1:
        current_vertex = vertex_visit_stack[-1]
        next_vertex = get_next_vertex(node=current_vertex)
        # print(current_vertex, next_vertex, vertex_status_list, vertex_visit_stack)
        time += 1
        if next_vertex and vertex_status_list[next_vertex] is UNVISITED:
            # print('on', current_vertex, next_vertex)
            vertex_status_list[next_vertex] = VISITED_IN_STACK
            vertex_d_time[next_vertex] += time
            vertex_visit_stack.append(next_vertex)
        else:
            # other_vertex = get_next_vertex(current_vertex)
            # print('stuck', current_vertex, other_vertex)
            vertex_visit_stack.pop()
            vertex_status_list[current_vertex] = POPPED_OUT
            vertex_f_time[current_vertex] += time

    return None

import sys

UNVISITED, VISITED_IN_STACK, POPPED_OUT = 0, 1, 2


def generate_adj_matrix(v_info):
    for v_detail in v_info:
        v_adj_list = v_detail[2:]
        assert len(v_adj_list) == int(v_detail[1])
        for each in v_adj_list:
            init_adj_matrix[int(v_detail[0]) - 1][int(each) - 1] = 1
    return init_adj_matrix


def graph_dfs(v_init):
    global time

    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    vertex_visit_stack.append(v_init)
    vertex_status_list[v_init] = VISITED_IN_STACK
    vertex_d_time[v_init] += time
    # init end

    while len(vertex_visit_stack) > 1:
        current_vertex = vertex_visit_stack[-1]
        next_vertex = get_adj_vertices(_vertex=current_vertex)

        if next_vertex:
            if vertex_status_list[next_vertex] is UNVISITED:
                vertex_status_list[next_vertex] = VISITED_IN_STACK
                time += 1
                vertex_d_time[next_vertex] += time
                vertex_visit_stack.append(next_vertex)
        else:
            vertex_visit_stack.pop()
            vertex_status_list[current_vertex] = POPPED_OUT
            time += 1
            vertex_f_time[current_vertex] += time

    return None


def get_adj_vertices(_vertex):
    for j in range(vertex_num):
        if adj_matrix[int(_vertex) - 1][j]:
            adj_matrix[int(_vertex) - 1][j] = 0
            return j + 1
    return None


def dfs_start():
    global time
    for i in range(vertex_num):
        if vertex_status_list[i + 1] == UNVISITED:
            # print('round', i + 1)
            graph_dfs(v_init=i + 1)
            time += 1

def depth_first_search(adj_matrix, n):
    visited = [None] * n
    count = 1
    searched = [None] * n
    start = 0
    stack = deque()
    stack.append(start)
    visited[start] = 1
    while count <= 2 * n:
        has_edge = adj_matrix[start]
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            if has_edge[i] and visited[i] is None:
                stack.append(i)
                count += 1
                visited[i] = count
                break
            i += 1
        if i < n:
            start = i
        else:
            searched_node = stack.pop()
            count += 1
            searched[searched_node] = count
            if len(stack) > 0:
                start = stack[-1]
            elif count < 2 * n:
                start = visited.index(None)
                stack.append(start)
                count += 1
                visited[start] = count
            else:
                break
    return visited, searched

class Verticies:
    def __init__(self, id, value, degree, adjs:list):
        self.id = id
        self.value = value
        self.degree = degree
        self.d = 0 # timesamp
        self.f = 0 # timesamp
        self.adjs = adjs

    def visit(self, ts):
        logging.debug("miso0a: visiting id(%s)" % self.id)
        if not self.is_visited():
            self.d = ts
            logging.debug("visited id(%s) and ts stamped as %s" % (self.id, ts))
            logging.info("id:%s d:%s f:%s (preorder)" % (self.id, self.d, self.f))
            ts+=1
            logging.debug("miso1: ts incremented as %s" % ts)
        return ts

    def all_visit(self, ts):
        if self.adjs_all_visited() and not self.adjs_all_stamped():
            self.f = ts
            logging.info("id:%s d:%s f:%s (=================)" % (self.id, self.d, self.f))
            ts +=1
        return ts

    def is_visited(self):
        logging.debug ("miso9: id(%s) is_visited: %s(%s)" % (self.id, not self.d == 0, self.d))
        return (not self.d == 0)

    def adjs_all_visited(self):
        visited = [v.is_visited() for v in self.adjs]
        logging.debug("miso5: %s" % self.adjs)
        logging.debug("miso(visited): %s" % visited)
        completed = all(visited)
        logging.debug("miso(completed): %s" % completed)
        return completed

    def adjs_all_stamped(self):
        stamped = [v.f != 0 for v in self.adjs]
        logging.debug("--- miso5 ---: %s" % [x.f for x in self.adjs])
        logging.debug("miso(stamped): %s" % stamped)
        completed = all(stamped)
        logging.debug("miso(completed): %s" % completed)
        return completed

    def get_adjs_info(self):
        return zip([v.id for v in self.adjs], [v.f for v in self.adjs])




def instanciate_vertex(V:list):
    vertex = {}
    for v in V:
        id = int(v[0])
        degree = v[1]
        adjs = v[2:]
        vertices = Verticies(id, 0, degree, adjs)
        vertex[id] = vertices
    # switch from string to Instance
    for id, vertices in vertex.items():
        vertex[id].adjs = [ vertex[i] for i in vertex[id].adjs]
    # sort by young id ascendence
    return sorted(list(vertex.values()), key=lambda v: v.id)

    global timer

    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    stack = list()
    stack.append(v_init)
    d_time[v_init] += timer
    # init end

        current = stack[-1]

                d_time[adj] += timer
                stack.append(adj)
        else:
            stack.pop()

            timer += 1
            f_time[current] += timer

import sys

UNVISITED, VISITED_IN_STACK, POPPED_OUT = 0, 1, 2


def generate_adj(v_info):
    for v_detail in v_info:
        v_adj_list = v_detail[2:]
        assert len(v_adj_list) == int(v_detail[1])
        for each in v_adj_list:
            init_adj_matrix[int(v_detail[0]) - 1][int(each) - 1] = 1
    return init_adj_matrix


def graph_dfs(v_init):
    global time
    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    vertex_visit_stack.append(v_init)
    vertex_status_list[v_init] = VISITED_IN_STACK
    vertex_d_time[v_init] += time
    # init end
    while len(vertex_visit_stack) > 1:
        current_vertex = vertex_visit_stack[-1]
        next_vertex = get_adj_vertices(_vertex=current_vertex)
        # print('start', current_vertex, next_vertex, vertex_status_list, vertex_visit_stack)

        if next_vertex:
            if vertex_status_list[next_vertex] is UNVISITED:
                vertex_status_list[next_vertex] = VISITED_IN_STACK
                time += 1
                vertex_d_time[next_vertex] += time
                vertex_visit_stack.append(next_vertex)
                # print('on', current_vertex, next_vertex, vertex_status_list, vertex_visit_stack)
        else:
            # print('no out degree', current_vertex)
            vertex_visit_stack.pop()
            vertex_status_list[current_vertex] = POPPED_OUT
            time += 1
            vertex_f_time[current_vertex] += time
        # print('end', current_vertex, vertex_status_list, vertex_visit_stack)

    return None

import sys
from collections import deque

UNVISITED, VISITED_IN_STACK, POPPED_OUT = 0, 1, 2


def generate_adj_matrix(v_info):
    for v_detail in v_info:
        v_index, adj_num, *adj_list = map(int, v_detail)
        # assert len(adj_list) == adj_num
        init_adj_table[v_index].extend(sorted(adj_list))
    return init_adj_table


def graph_dfs(v_init):
    global time

    # init the first node of overall graph iterations(times >= 1)
    stack.append(v_init)
    color[v_init] = VISITED_IN_STACK
    d_time[v_init] += time
    # init end

    while len(stack) > 1:
        current = stack[-1]
        v_table = adj_table[current]
        adj = v_table.popleft() if v_table else None

        if adj:
            if color[adj] is UNVISITED:
                color[adj] = VISITED_IN_STACK
                time += 1
                d_time[adj] += time
                stack.append(adj)
        else:
            stack.pop()
            color[current] = POPPED_OUT
            time += 1
            f_time[current] += time

    return None

    list_colors[u] = 1  # uを訪問
    time += 1
    d[u] = time
    for v in range(len(list_colors)):  # v:次に探索する場所
        if adj_mat[u][v] == 0:  # uからvに行く辺がないなら次へ
            continue
        if list_colors[v] == 0:  # uからvに道があるかつ行ったことがないなら行く。
            list_colors, time, d, f = dfs_visit(
                u=v, list_colors=list_colors, adj_mat=adj_mat, d=d, f=f, time=time
